decisions.reason: Cites LinkType Junction with Target to the repo and the link: install marker; concludes repo edits are already deployed and Copy-Item was never right because both paths are one physical directory, contrasted with a copied dependency.

Assigns both the EBUSY file handles and the stale served/cached client bundle to the running dsh web host; tab close releases nothing; browser HTTP cache is kept distinct from the filesystem lock and the fix requires host restart plus hard refresh.

Explains the junction made the profile-path renames hit the only physical files so the later source copy failed; recovery renames both .old2 files back with contents preserved, verifies with node --check, then activates; stopping the host first is allowed.

Order is fully stop host, restart dsh web, hard-refresh to bypass cache, then verify served bytes, feature, host route, and console errors; notes a refresh/tab-close is not a host stop and plain refresh of a live tab can show old code.

Preflight inspects LinkType/Target and the cordis.patch.yml link: marker before any file operation with linked-vs-copied branching, and explains the generic copy-into-node_modules advice is a self-copy that mutates the only source.

caps.reason: Final plan copies nothing; it renames the .old2 files back and explicitly calls copying a self-copy/no-op.
Final plan stops and restarts the host before any refresh; browser-only measures are explicitly rejected as insufficient.
